system.description: When you face certain death, roll the dice, adding the number of your conditions marked.

success.value:
The audience chooses one option from the following list. Once an option has been chosen, it is crossed off; nobody may choose it again.

  • Someone (you choose) saves you just in time.

  • Take a distinctive, but sexy, scar.

  • Gain a permanent debility (a limp, an eyepatch, etc.).

  • Become a twisted, evil version of yourself.

  • Suffer amnesia.

  • Return with a new face. ӹ Wind up in a (possibly) long term coma.

  • Wind up actually dead. (This option may always be chosen.)
